title: Rome in one day: 8 stops, one route
text:
Rome in one day 🇮🇹 8 stops, one walking route.

08:00  St. Peter's Basilica
09:30  Castel Sant'Angelo
11:00  Pantheon
12:30  Roman Forum
14:00  Circus Maximus
14:45  Colosseum
16:30  Santa Maria Maggiore
17:30  Archbasilica of St. John Lateran

Before you go: St. Peter's is often closed on Wednesday mornings, and Castel Sant'Angelo on Mondays. Book the Colosseum ahead. In winter, last entry is 15:30.

title: Istanbul in one day: 8 stops with a tip each
text:
Istanbul in one day 🇹🇷 8 stops from Sultanahmet to the Bosphorus. Swipe for a tip at every stop →

08:30  Sultan Ahmed Mosque
09:30  Hagia Sophia
11:00  Basilica Cistern
12:00  Topkapı Palace
14:30  Dolmabahçe Palace
16:15  Galata Tower
17:30  Süleymaniye Mosque
19:00  Maiden's Tower

Not all on foot: take the T1 tram to Kabataş for Dolmabahçe, and the ferry to Üsküdar for the Maiden's Tower.

title: The name on the sign isn't the one in your guide
text:
Your guide says Hagia Sophia. The sign says Ayasofya. 8 famous sights, by the names you'll actually see on the street →

Colosseum = Colosseo
Roman Forum = Foro Romano
St. Peter's Basilica = Basilica di San Pietro
Sultan Ahmed Mosque = Sultanahmet Camii
Hagia Sophia = Ayasofya
Basilica Cistern = Yerebatan Sarnıcı
Maiden's Tower = Kız Kulesi
Eiffel Tower = Tour Eiffel
